decisions.reason: A startup accelerator is only loosely tied to the firm's machinery and recycling know-how, so its value is harder to absorb, but it has stayed on the home page and costs little to keep as a source of external knowledge.

The bio-based bitumen binder moves into materials chemistry beyond the firm's core machinery knowledge, but its own research and development and its CO2-negative flagship positioning support continuing to learn from it.

The infectious-waste decontamination plant builds directly on the firm's modular WASTX recycling technology and a manufacturing partnership with ERMAFA, so the firm can readily interpret and improve it, and it remains the featured flagship.
